markdown:
The Wallcovering Guide

# Before the first *length is cut.*

The sample is only the start. Make sense of the material, the wall and the work before committing to a room.

## Choose, specify, source, prepare, install.

Each stage has its own pages. Start where your project is.

### Choose

What should go on this wall?

  - [**Find a material family**Compare appearance and everyday use, then shortlist.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/materials/#material-finder)
  - [**Rooms we have hung**Projects with the maker and the paper named.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/projects/)
  - [**Choosing wallcoverings**What to ask of a paper before you fall for it.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/choosing-wallcoverings/)

### Specify

How do I write it down so it is hung as drawn?

  - [**Plan a professional package**Designers, developers and hotels.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/professionals/)
  - [**Designer checklist**What a schedule needs before a roll is ordered.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/designer-specification-checklist/)
  - [**Hotel wallcoverings**Corridors, rooms and the spare stock a hotel keeps.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/hotel-wallcovering-specification/)
  - [**Fire ratings & standards**Evidence to request for a commercial specification.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/wallcovering-fire-ratings-uk/)

### Source

Where do I buy it, and from whom?

  - [**Where to buy**How wallpaper is sold, samples, lead times and duty.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/where-to-buy/)
  - [**Makers directory**Design approaches, material families and official sources.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/makers/)
  - [**Official buying routes**Shops, showroom enquiries, trade access and samples.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/buying-routes/)
  - [**Makers we have hung**In our own photographs, with the projects.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/materials/#makers-installed)
  - [**Help choosing the paper**We help you choose, then hang it.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/contact/?intent=source)

### Prepare

How much do I order, and what does the wall need?

  - [**Wallpaper calculator**Working rolls, a separate spare and a cutting plan.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/calculator/)
  - [**How much wallpaper to order**The method with worked examples.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/quantities/)
  - [**Preparation by wall type**Treatment, primer and lining guidance.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/wallpapering/preparation/)
  - [**Lining & adhesives**Product sources and house practice.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/wallpapering/lining-and-adhesives/)
  - [**Wall preparation**What to establish about the wall before hanging.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/wall-preparation/)

### Install

Who hangs it, and how is it done well?

  - [**Our installation expertise**What we hang, and for whom.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/services/)
  - [**Set-out and pattern matching**Where the first drop goes, and why.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/set-out-and-pattern-matching/)
  - [**Seams, corners and edges**Close-ups from our own jobs.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/details/)
  - [**Care and repairs**What to expect after the hang.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/aftercare/)

[How we check](https://www.mrwallcover.com/how-we-check/) Our evidence rules, publication checks and corrections.

Adam’s Eden at Brown’s Hotel, Mayfair. Mr Wallcover photograph.

01 / choosing

## [Choosing wallcoverings](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/choosing-wallcoverings/)

How to choose a wallcovering that still looks right once it is on the wall: traffic, light, cleaning, moisture, sample size and the questions to settle before ordering.

[Read the guide](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/choosing-wallcoverings/)

![Close detail of a woven grasscloth wallcovering turning an external corner, the weave running straight and tight to the edge.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/media/img/r/fs-residences-06-800.webp)

Natural weave at an external corner, Four Seasons residences. Mr Wallcover photograph.

02 / choosing

## [Grasscloth seams and variation](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/grasscloth-seams-and-variation/)

Grasscloth seams show and panels vary in shade. What is normal, what is a fault, how the set-out and the batch change the result, and what to settle before you order.

[Read the guide](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/grasscloth-seams-and-variation/)

Illustrative study

Pause motion

03 / preparing

## [Wall preparation](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/wall-preparation/)

How to tell whether a wall is ready for wallcovering: old coatings, dryness, soundness, filling and sanding, lining paper, priming and what needs a site inspection.

[Read the guide](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/wall-preparation/)

Illustrative study

Pause motion

04 / planning

## [How much wallpaper to order](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/quantities/)

Count drops, not square metres: how the repeat, half-drop, doors and windows change the order, with worked examples, and a link to the calculator.

[Read the guide](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/quantities/)

Illustrative study

Pause motion

05 / planning

## [Installation cost](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/installation-cost/)

Why there is no honest price per roll: measured area, repeat and wastage, wall preparation, the material, access and protection, and what a quotation should include.

[Read the guide](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/installation-cost/)

Illustrative study

Pause motion

06 / planning

## [Hand-painted papers and murals](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/hand-painted-murals-set-out/)

How a scenic or hand-painted paper is set out: elevations, the focal point, panel sequence, doors and corners, finished dimensions and when the survey has to happen.

[Read the guide](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/hand-painted-murals-set-out/)

Illustrative study

Pause motion

07 / planning

## [Hotel wallcoverings](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/hotel-wallcovering-specification/)

Specifying wallcoverings for an occupied hotel: cleaning and durability, the sample room, batch control, phasing around guests, product documents, spares and handover.

[Read the guide](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/hotel-wallcovering-specification/)

Illustrative study

Pause motion

08 / planning

## [Designer checklist](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/designer-specification-checklist/)

What a wallcovering specification needs before site: maker and code, elevations, repeat and match, samples, light, lining, free-issue responsibilities and change control.

[Read the guide](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/designer-specification-checklist/)

Illustrative study

Pause motion

09 / planning

## [Developer package](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/developer-wallcovering-package/)

What a wallcovering package needs to be priced, programmed and handed over: scope, measurement basis, substrate handover, programme, changes, snagging and spares.

[Read the guide](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/developer-wallcovering-package/)

Illustrative study

Pause motion

10 / caring

## [Problems and aftercare](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/wallcovering-problems-and-aftercare/)

What to do when a wallcovering bubbles, lifts or marks: what to photograph and record, what not to touch, how to clean each material, and when an inspection is needed.

[Read the guide](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/wallcovering-problems-and-aftercare/)

Illustrative study

Pause motion

11 / planning

## [Hotel fire safety](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/hotel-fire-safety-and-compliance/)

Where a hotel wallcovering's fire classification comes from, why it belongs to the tested build-up, what the installer does, and the RAMS, insurance and handover papers that come with the package.

[Read the guide](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/hotel-fire-safety-and-compliance/)

Illustrative study

Pause motion

12 / planning

## [Ceilings and staircases](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/papered-ceilings-and-staircases/)

What changes when the paper goes overhead or up a stair: the order of work in a room, relief papers on ceilings, cutting around lanterns and roses, heritage ceilings, stair-wall set-out and why stairs need a larger allowance.

[Read the guide](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/papered-ceilings-and-staircases/)

![Setting out an Overture panel against a laser line.](https://www.mrwallcover.com/media/img/r/lee-broom-06-800.webp)

Setting out Overture to a laser line. Photograph: Dorin Burcus.

13 / planning

## [Set-out and pattern matching](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/set-out-and-pattern-matching/)

Where the first drop goes and why: setting out from a focal point, setting a true vertical with a laser in a room that is not square, matching across joints and corners, balancing the end panels, hanging murals in order, and joining wide vinyl by overlap and splice.

[Read the guide](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/set-out-and-pattern-matching/)

Illustrative study

Pause motion

14 / planning

## [Fire ratings & standards](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/wallcovering-fire-ratings-uk/)

What B-s1,d0 and Class 0 mean, England's Table 6.1 and the other UK nations, and what named makers' documents show for specific commercial wallcoverings.

[Read the guide](https://www.mrwallcover.com/advice/wallcovering-fire-ratings-uk/)

A question about your project?

## Start with what you know.

Tell us about the room or send the material you are considering. We can discuss preparation, installation or the complete package.

[Discuss your project](https://www.mrwallcover.com/contact/?intent=advice) [Care and repairs](https://www.mrwallcover.com/aftercare/)

By [Dorin Burcus](https://www.mrwallcover.com/about/#dorin), founder · Last reviewed 9 October 2026
